author: (Temminck & Schlegel, 1850)

note.en: A small pale remora that lives inside the gill cavities and mouths of mantas and other large rays, so it is almost never seen by people.
note.es: Una rémora pequeña y pálida que vive dentro de las cavidades branquiales y bocas de mantas y otras rayas grandes, por lo que casi nunca la ven las personas.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: Only a FishBase country listing; no local record, open-ocean species.

marks.en: Slim pale to whitish fish with a sucker disc on top of the head and a projecting lower jaw.
marks.es: Pez delgado pálido a blanquecino con disco adhesivo sobre la cabeza y mandíbula inferior prominente.
